anatomy: BIG MOUTH is the original Metal Gear Survive boss in the supplied genuine released-game captures. Huge low hunched nonhuman mutant with enormous front mouth/head, thick gloss-black violet crystalline armour, thin sharp yellow stripes running over tall domed shoulder/back plates, patches of pale purplish exposed flesh at throat and belly. Large tooth-lined mouth with hook-shaped irregular black crystal mandibles and tusklike teeth, two thick hind legs with broad clawed feet, exactly two powerful front forelimbs with large hooked crystalline claws and a tapering spiked long tail trailing behind. Match its photographed squatting gorilla-like reptilian four-limbed stance. It is NOT a humanoid Wanderer, NOT a dinosaur T-rex with tiny arms, NOT a robot. No human head/face, shirt, trousers, shoes, red head spike, rifle, straps, tie or ordinary eyes. Back and hidden reverse detail are conservative interpretations from visible source evidence, never claim unseen exact topology.
